name: Hat ENV-III
summary: Measures temperature, relative humidity and atmospheric pressure.

interface.alternate_qmp_address: 0x56 exists in the driver and some documentation; confirm the attached hardware.

host_bindings.notes: Legacy examples use StickC SDA0/SCL26. StickS3 has a different Hat2-Bus; inspect the HAT schematic and mating orientation before assigning pins. Do not use Grove GPIO9/10 for a directly attached HAT or infer GPIO26 from a StickC example. Use 3.3V, not 5V, for these HAT supply pins.

support.meaning: Manufacturer documentation and source review only. No accessory driver or emulator input is implemented by this record.

first_hardware_check: Inspect HAT seating, 3.3V and actual StickS3 GPIO mapping before configuring I2C.
Check SHT30 at 0x44 and QMP6988 at 0x70 on that bus; if absent, inspect revision and documented 0x56 alternate rather than changing unrelated pins.
Read all three values and their validity; allow temperature to settle away from fingers/device heat.
troubleshooting: Do not substitute ENV-II/BMP280 or ENV-IV/SHT40/BMP280 code.
The QMP driver default argument is 0x56 but the vendor ENV-III HAT example explicitly chooses QMP6988_SLAVE_ADDRESS_L=0x70.
Different addresses do not make two physical HATs stackable; check space, wiring and pull-ups.

app_fixture_plan.note: Use app-owned fixtures with units/validity; do not present generated values as real sensor data.

libraries.name: M5Unit-ENV
libraries.author: M5Stack
libraries.purpose: SHT3X/QMP6988 drivers and ENV-III HAT example; adapt bus pins explicitly.
